method.impact: judge_count + sum of critic severity weights (blocker 12, major 6, minor 3, nit 1); ties broken by the weakest affected route (lowest min(light,dark,390) critic score) first
method.judge_count: number of the 1264 judge reasons that cite this tell (joined with the blind key; a reason naming several tells counts for each). 1 judgment of 304 was wrong (org-members light content, pair p150; the judge called it close to a guess); its 4 reasons are included where they name a tell.
method.note_tooling: "tooling" = not a theme defect; fix belongs to integrator/tools (capture/seed).
